name: printable-calendar
description: Print a calendar for the year with your holidays and events already written in. Get a monthly calendar with a page per month and big boxes to write in, and a year-at-a-glance page. Optionally pick a list of dates — holidays, make-up working days, birthdays, trips, deadlines — or type holidays straight into the settings. Choose the year and months, Monday or Sunday start, A4 or Letter, Chinese and English labels, week numbers and your colour. Runs locally; no design service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 打印一份已经写好节假日和你自己安排的日历。生成每月一页、格子够大可以手写的月历，以及一页看全年的年历。可以选一份日期清单——节假日、调休补班、生日、出差、截止日——也可以直接在设置里输入节假日。年份和月份、每周从周一还是周日开始、A4 或 Letter、中英文、周数和主题色都能选。在本地运行，不用设计服务，无需 API 密钥。
